audience.prompt: Team 3 is free. Where does it go?

a.name: Braunsfeld Depot
a.consequence: 989 people and 600,000 EUR of value get a team; the power asset stays on the watch list.

b.name: Ossendorf Works
b.consequence: 1,721 people and 4,200,000 EUR of value get a team; the power asset stays on the watch list.

audience.tradeoff: A substation on open road keeps power on. Dense housing keeps people safe. Both are defensible; the room decides.

assessment.title: GeoResponse assessment — Cologne construction watch
assessment.summary: Cologne construction watch affects 29 km². 12 priority sites remain after review; 0 finding(s) were rejected by an analyst. The top three sites (C08, C02, C05) carry €25,100,000 of exposed value and 10,339 people within 700 m. Three response teams are allocated by urgency, access and value at risk.
assessment.headline: The highest-ranked site is Ossendorf Works (C08), severity red, confidence 80%. A 11,764 m² change intersects clear access; 1,721 people live within 700 m and the insured value is €4,200,000.
limitations: Change extent is derived from a simulated Sentinel-2-like 10 m composite in the demo pack; production uses licensed imagery.
Dark roofs, wet pavement and deep shadow can mimic structural damage; every rejection is retained in the audit trail.
Population is a 700 m radius estimate from the demo population grid, not a household count.
No site is approved automatically. A human analyst signs the assessment before any claim or dispatch decision.
